caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric oriented horizontally on a plain, off-white background. The fabric contains multiple horizontal bands of patterns and colors. The left and upper portions of the rectangle are mostly a light, creamy color with faint lines, and they occupy about one third of the area. Across the middle section, there are alternating narrow stripes of color and patterns; these include light browns, pinks, yellows, dark blues, and greens. The right side of the fabric features several narrow horizontal bands in bright, saturated colors such as blue, red, green, yellow, and pink, interspersed with darker lines. Many of the bands have intricate repeating designs, such as zigzags, crosses, dots, and wavy lines, usually rendered in shades of brown and gold. The overall composition is contained within an uneven, hand-drawn outline of the textile, which appears slightly wavy along the edges. The background remains unadorned, with only the textile as the central focus.
title: Textile Detail
